tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
You've chosen your artist. What can eyebrow permanent makeup do for you?

Every woman knows how tricky it can sometimes be to get her brows just right.
Especially when the hairs grow unruly, are sparse or light in color or, on the contrary, too coarse and thick. Every day you have to stand in front of the mirror, constantly correcting the shape and color with a pencil or another cosmetic product. And then, all day long, you keep checking the mirror to make sure your brows haven't lost their look.

Eyebrow micropigmentation eliminates absolutely every hassle of doing makeup in this area. The procedure takes only 1.5 hours and gives your brows a perfect look: color, shape, outline, length, density and thickness. The effect lasts at least 1.5–2 years. Once your brow color becomes very light or fades completely, you can always repeat the eyebrow permanent makeup procedure, choosing whichever technique suits you.

Key benefits of eyebrow tattooing

Eyebrow micropigmentation is valuable for more than aesthetics alone. It also helps solve a number of problems that used to cause you discomfort:

  • irregular brow shape, length and color;
  • sparse brows, hair loss and brows with visible gaps;
  • a complete absence of brows;
  • hairs that are too light or gray, which can be covered with a richer, more beautiful shade;
  • allergic reactions to makeup products;
  • lack of time for makeup, not feeling up to it, or being unable to do your makeup every day.

Whatever you want to achieve with eyebrow permanent makeup, if the procedure is performed professionally, all of these challenges will be solved. You'll get fresh-looking brows in a natural shade and shape that suit you perfectly. Provided, of course, that you come to Studio LBar.
tvs.title-bl-seo: Why the portfolio matters: eyebrow micropigmentation photos before and after the procedure
tvs.text-bl-seo:
Before you choose an artist for your eyebrow permanent makeup and book a procedure, it's important to look at before and after micropigmentation photos. Why? To assess the artist's level of training and experience. Photos of semi-permanent eyebrow makeup will help you see whether you want the same result on your own face, whether you like the work and how your brows will look. That's why we always recommend reviewing a portfolio of eyebrow micropigmentation work before making your decision.

Photos always reveal an artist's level of skill. If the brows look unnatural, the shade is too intense or too light, it doesn't match the skin's color type, or the portfolio has no or very few eyebrow tattoo photos, any of these can be a reason to turn down that artist and their services.
